summary: Fix a reaction-window deadlock found by the #818 arena (issue #825, also #820): a held action whose Gold source is bowed or destroyed while its window is open is now aborted (nothing paid, nothing resolves) instead of making declineReaction fail for ever; payments suggested to a Reaction never reuse the held action's sources; the bot never negates its own held action. Also adds the L5R_ARENA_SPEC=818 arena switch and stall diagnostics.
validation: Reproduced all 4 stalled arena games (+1 timeout) before the fix, all decided after it. Core 3476/3476, AI 146/146 (new: HeldPaymentBrokenAborts, NeverNegatesOwnAction). Full 440-game arena rerun result recorded in the PR.
remaining: Cause analysis: the bot negated its own action with Yasuki Jinn-Kuen, paying with a Holding the held action had named; engine fault was that the window could not be closed afterwards; UI not involved.
